summary: One observable outcome: the tuned game paces to target - a blind first playthrough completes in 90-120 minutes, the expert critical path in 55-75 minutes without artificially slowing experts, the first 10 minutes deliver the full section 53 tutorial flow, and the 3-6 minute notable-beat rule holds across all bands. Difficulty-curve config (oxygen rates, WORLD_CURRENT_FIELDS current strengths, pressure/gate thresholds per section 39), density/travel data (section 49: 20-60 s meaningful points, sparing 1-2 min transits, no empty corridors), and section 53 tutorial beats are three changed responsibilities, at the leaf limit, all config/data-only - the spec forbids new simulation rules, redesign, and new content, routing such findings to the normal defect/fix-planning route. Subsystems: balance tuning (a concrete config/data-tuning role defined in ST-07, not a gameplay umbrella); one named subsystem, a strict subset of the parent's four. Criteria AC-bal-timing and AC-bal-flow are carried verbatim from ST-07; the union across WI-07a/b/c/d covers all four parent criteria, and WI-07c is the story's named final proof owner of AC-bal-timing (tuning clause closes only when recorded blind and expert runs land in target) and sole owner of AC-bal-flow, with no other child re-asserting tuning. depends_on [WI-07a, WI-07b] is correct: both siblings, no ancestor/descendant edges, both genuinely required (telemetry to measure the runs; provable reachability and material completeness before timing is trusted), and matches the story's ordering that WI-07c finishes the tuning leaves. Request sections were checked against the leaf: section 3 targets and expert/pacing rules, section 39 curve shape (forgiving early, O2 route-planning mid, ecology/navigation tension deep, altered-context finale), section 49 density rules, section 53 minute beats with no lore dump, section 71 fields, and phase 8's seven recorded beats all match the specification's boundaries. Evidence is focused and auditable: two recorded instrumented playthrough exports with the section 71 fields and readable beats (claimed from recorded playtest evidence only, never headless math), a headless fresh-save first-10-minutes scenario asserting the section 53 flow and no lore dump, a pacing scenario asserting 3-6 min beat gaps, config-only changes, and green suite/build. Handoff names the story, the relevant request sections, the two siblings with what to take from each, and existing file pointers (src/game/constants.ts, src/world/worldData.ts including WORLD_CURRENT_FIELDS, src/content/recipes.ts, section 53 beats), so a fresh implementer can proceed without reconstructing the project. No findings requiring split or revise.
